name: Timeline Ad Studio
description: A product photo and its benefits in, three timeline ads out — the direct-response format that shows results building over time (Day 1, Week 4, Month 3) — each on a different hook, in your brand's look, with the product exactly as photographed.
markdownDescription:
## Timeline Ad Studio

A product photo and its benefits become three timeline ads — the direct-response format that shows results building over time — each on a different hook, in your brand's look. The product stays exactly as photographed.

1. **Product photo** — a clean packshot. The hero of every ad.
2. **Product notes** — what it is and what it does over time, in your words. Nothing invented.
3. **Moodboard + Brand notes** — a picture of your brand world (optional) and a line on colours and tone.
4. **Brand look** — an AI turns those into one paragraph every ad follows.
5. **Three concepts** — one writer per hook: a bold promise, a before-and-after, social proof. Each writes a headline, three stages and a small line.
6. **Three ads** — portrait, one per concept. Edit a concept by hand and rerun its ad; copy a pair for a fourth hook.

Brand look
data.userInput: Brand notes: {Brand notes || a calm, clean, premium brand.} The reference image, if there is one, is the brand moodboard. Write the brand look.
data.systemPrompt: You define the visual world of a brand for an image generator. From the moodboard image, if there is one, and the brand notes, write ONE paragraph of 60 to 90 words, plain English: the two or three colours that dominate and the one accent, the finish of surfaces (matte, glossy, paper, marble), the typography feel (serif or sans, light or bold, upper or lower case), the layout energy (minimal and airy, or dense), the light and the mood. If the product's own colour would clash with that palette, say which colour harmony to use instead. No headings, no lists. Output only the paragraph.

data.label: Concept A · Bold promise
data.userInput: Product notes: {Product notes || a daily supplement whose results build over weeks.} Brand look: {Brand look || calm, clean, premium: ivory, charcoal and one warm accent.} The reference image is the product. Write the concept.
data.systemPrompt:
You are a senior performance creative strategist who designs timeline benefit ads — the direct-response format that shows a product's results building over time, stage by stage. You get the product notes, the brand look, and a photo of the product. Write ONE concept with this hook angle: a bold promise — state the result plainly and confidently.
Answer in exactly this shape, plain English, nothing else:
Headline: "<the hook, at most seven words>"
Stage 1: "<time marker, for example Day 1> — <benefit, at most eight words>"
Stage 2: "<time marker> — <benefit, at most eight words>"
Stage 3: "<time marker> — <benefit, at most eight words>"
Small line: "<one short proof, claim or call to action, at most ten words>"
Look: <one paragraph of 60 to 90 words: the background colour and finish from the brand look, where the product sits (large, on one side or behind the timeline), how the three stages are laid out (a vertical or horizontal timeline with visible markers), the typography, the light and the mood. The product from the packshot is the hero and stays exactly as it is.>
Use only benefits the product notes support; never invent clinical numbers or studies. No other headings, no lists, no commentary.

data.label: Ad A
data.prompt: Finished portrait 3:4 timeline benefit ad for a social feed, built from this brief: {Concept A · Bold promise || Headline: "Skin that keeps its promises." Stage 1: "Day 1 — Drinks in, hydration you can feel." Stage 2: "Week 4 — Firmer to the touch." Stage 3: "Month 3 — Fine lines look softer." Small line: "Clinically tested. One scoop a day." Look: an ivory matte background, the product large on the left, a vertical timeline with three round rose-gold markers on the right, charcoal serif type, soft warm light.} The reference image is the product — it must appear exactly as it is, with its own jar, lid, label and colours, large and sharp. Render the headline, the three stage lines (each time marker with its benefit) and the small line exactly as written in the brief — same words, same spelling — and no other text. Lay the three stages out as a clear timeline with visible markers, in reading order, each benefit next to its marker; the product on one side or behind the timeline, never covering the text. Background colour, finish and typography from the brief's Look. Crisp typography, generous margins, no watermark.
